source.name: Development Sectors in CSR (MCA CSR Exchange)
source.law: Schedule VII, Companies Act 2013, as amended

notes: Groups and descriptions are from the source PDF; these are the groups the National CSR Portal (csr.gov.in) uses for sector-wise CSR spend.
Sectors are the finer development-sector labels used in MCA CSR filings and csr.gov.in reports. Labels are as commonly published; check them against csr.gov.in before loading spend data.
schedule_vii gives the Schedule VII item numbers each group comes from.
open_to_ngos is false for contributions to government funds and public institutions, which an NGO cannot receive.
maps_to links each sector to SANGAM sector-* and pop-* tags for matching; sdgs are SANGAM's mapping, not part of the law.

groups.label: Health, Eradicating Hunger, Poverty and Malnutrition, Safe Drinking Water, Sanitation
groups.description: Eradicating hunger, poverty and malnutrition, promoting health care including preventive health care and sanitation including contribution to the Swach Bharat Kosh set-up by the Central Government for the promotion of sanitation and making available safe drinking water.

sectors.label: Swachh Bharat Kosh
sectors.note: Government fund contribution, not open to NGOs

groups.label: Education, Differently Abled, Livelihood
groups.description: Promoting education, including special education and employment enhancing vocation skills especially among children, women, elderly and the differently abled and livelihood enhancement projects

groups.label: Gender Equality, Women Empowerment, Old Age Homes, Reducing Inequalities
groups.description: Promoting gender equality, empowering women, setting up homes and hostels for women and orphans; setting up old age homes, day care centers and such other facilities for senior citizens and measures for reducing inequalities faced by socially and economically backward groups.

sectors.label: Setting Up Homes And Hostels For Women

groups.label: Environment, Animal Welfare, Conservation of Resources
groups.description: Ensuring environmental sustainability, ecological balance, protection of flora and fauna, animal welfare, agroforestry, conservation of natural resources and maintaining quality of soil, air and water.

groups.label: Clean Ganga Fund
groups.description: Contribution to the Clean Ganga Fund set-up by the Central Government for rejuvenation of the river Ganga

sectors.label: Clean Ganga Fund
sectors.note: Government fund contribution, not open to NGOs

groups.label: Heritage Art and Culture
groups.description: Protection of national heritage, art and culture including restoration of buildings and sites of historical importance and works of art; setting up public libraries; promotion and development of traditional art and handicrafts

groups.label: Other Sectors (Technology Incubator and Benefits to Armed Forces and Admin Overheads)
groups.description: Contribution to incubators or research and development projects in the field of science, technology, engineering and medicine, funded by the Central Government or State Government or Public Sector Undertaking or any agency of the Central Government or State Government; and measures for the benefit of armed forces veterans, war widows and their dependents, Central Armed Police Forces (CAPF) and Central Para Military Forces (CPMF) veterans, and their dependents including widows.

sectors.label: Armed Forces Veterans, War Widows And Dependents
Admin Overheads
sectors.note: The company's own CSR administration, capped by the CSR Rules; not a programme area

groups.label: Encouraging Sports
groups.description: Training to promote rural sports, nationally recognised sports, Paralympic sports and Olympic sports

groups.label: Prime Minister's National Relief Fund
groups.description: Contribution to the prime minister's national relief fund or Prime Minister's Citizen Assistance and Relief in Emergency Situations Fund (PM CARES Fund) or any other fund set up by the central govt. for socio economic development and relief and welfare of the schedule caste, tribes, other backward classes, minorities and women

sectors.label: Prime Minister's National Relief Fund
sectors.note: Government fund contribution, not open to NGOs

groups.label: Any Other Fund
groups.description: Contributions to public funded Universities; IITs; National Laboratories and autonomous bodies under DAE, DBT, DST, Department of Pharmaceuticals, AYUSH, MeitY and other bodies (DRDO, ICAR, ICMR, CSIR) engaged in research in science, technology, engineering and medicine aimed at promoting the SDGs

groups.label: Disaster Management
groups.description: Including relief, rehabilitation and reconstruction activities
